languages.tagline: Where all hope dies and the Badlands begin.

sections.heading: Welcome
body: # Welcome to NIMBY
Hardcore survival on Nasdara, the Badlands map. Fresh world as of October 15, 2026.
Restarts every 12 hours at 12 AM and 12 PM Central (US). Server location: Chicago, IL (US Central).

This window opens each time you join. Tick **Don't show this again** before you close it and it stays closed; when something changes that everyone should see (rules, a new release, a loot change), it comes back once. You can reopen it any time with the Greet key (default **Insert**) or from the pause menu under **Server welcome**.

sections.heading: The one rule
body: # Don't be a dick.
That is the whole rulebook. There are no PvP or PvE zones, no safe zones, and no rules on how you play: choose your own adventure.

sections.heading: Discord
body: # Discord
Our Discord is the place for questions, reports, and the mod roadmap. Ask in the faq-and-help channel or ping an admin.
[Join the NIMBY Discord](https://discord.gg/kH3eJ5mdEv)
**Open** launches the invite in your default browser (DayZ cannot show it in the Steam overlay). **Copy** puts the link on your clipboard, so you can paste it to someone else:
https://discord.gg/kH3eJ5mdEv

sections.heading: How to join
body: # How to join
| Item | Detail |
| Launcher | DZSA Launcher or the in-game browser: search **NIMBY Badlands** |
| Requires | The Badlands DLC. Nasdara servers do not let you in without it |
| Version | DayZ 1.30. Your game must match the server build |
| Mods | The @NIMBY Workshop item (see the Mods tab). Subscribe once; the launcher keeps it current |
| Slots | 80 |
| Location | Chicago, IL (US Central) |

sections.heading: Restarts
body: # Restarts
| When | What |
| 12:00 AM Central | Restart |
| 12:00 PM Central | Restart |
| 15, 5, and 1 minute before | Warning in chat |
| 5 minutes before | The server locks to new joins to prevent abuse |
Find a safe spot and log out before the reboot.

sections.heading: Difficulty
body: # Full hardcore
- First person only
- No crosshair
- No personal light. Nights are dark; bring a light source.
- Server time is persistent, so a restart can land you in the middle of the night.
## Why the browser says 3rd & 1st Person

DayZ 1.30 added a separate third-person setting for vehicles, and it looks to be on by default. Bohemia has not published its name yet, so we cannot turn it off. On foot you are locked to first person. Once the setting is documented, we switch it off and the label goes back to first person only.

sections.heading: Enhanced Vanilla
body: # Vanilla-plus, not easier
- **Weight hits harder.** The stamina penalty starts at 5 kg carried (vanilla is 6 kg) and costs 2% per kg (vanilla is 1.75%). At 15 kg you have 80% stamina instead of 84%.
- **No hit direction indicator.** The red hit flash stays; find the shooter by sound.
- **More base building spots.** Placement angle and collision checks are relaxed.
Loot is tuned release by release; see **What's changed**.

sections.heading: Mods
body: # Mods
One Workshop item, **@NIMBY**. Keys rebind in Options, Controls, NIMBY.
| Mod | What it does |
| Legs | Autorun. Double-tap Left Shift; any move, fire or raise stops it |
| Ears | Earplugs. N lowers effect volume, N again restores. Voice unaffected |
| Scrawl | Notes. Pen in hands, drop a sheet on it, hold the action key to write; hold left mouse to read. Notes last 30 days |
| Greet | This window. Insert reopens it, or Server welcome in the pause menu |
| Hands | Hold an item, press O to offer it; they take it from your hands. Empty hands and O asks for theirs. Bind open or close pockets to accept into pockets |
| Tack | Pin a sheet: hammer in hands and a nail in inventory, or tape, epoxy or a knife in hands; look at the wall, hold the action key. Take down twice returns it; the third ruins it |
| DPV | Patrol buggy at military sites. Bring battery, spark plug, bulbs, fuel. Rails take cans, packs, tents; roof a crate, car tent or bear; cabin a first aid kit |

sections.heading: What's changed
body: # What's changed
**November 2026, release 2**

- **DPV.** A desert patrol buggy at military sites, four to six on the map, each on its wheels; find a battery, spark plug, bulbs and fuel. Rails carry cans, packs and tents, the roof a crate, car tent or teddy bear, the cabin a first aid kit. Near 140 km/h (87 mph) flat out.

- **Loot.** The Oasis tents no longer rain golden guns: golden AK and mags, golden Deagle and Magnum are a handful per map, counted wherever they are, slow to return; FAL and wooden VSD one at a time; plate carriers and the Akinaka rarer; night vision only from the active bunker crate. The 1911 family and binoculars half as common.
- **Hands.** Handing an item to another player works again.
**October 2026, release 1**
- Legs, Ears, Scrawl, Greet, Hands and Tack shipped as @NIMBY. Paper and pens spawn; whetstones up; barrels, 10-round CMAGs and the Luger down; crash sites fewer and lighter.

sections.heading: Questions
body: # Questions
**How do I invite someone to this Discord?** Send them the invite link. The **Copy** button on the Discord tab puts it on your clipboard.
[NIMBY Discord invite](https://discord.gg/kH3eJ5mdEv)
Anything else: ask in the faq-and-help channel or ping an admin.
